Alex L: Heads-up: Helion Analytics raised a ticket — they were billed twice for embeddings on invoice INV-2026-0810-HL. Claim: duplicate line for 2026-08-01 usage. Can we check and credit?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0810-HL posted 2026-08-10 07:45Z. Total: $12,340.00. Status: paid. PDF: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0810-HL

Nina (Acct Rep): Customer attached screenshot showing two identical lines: "Embeddings - v2" qty 1 unit_price $6,000 line_total $6,000 (x2). They paid already.

Alex L: pasted invoice fragment:
```
line,description,qty,unit_price,line_total
1,Embeddings - v2 (2026-08-01),1,6000.00,6000.00
2,Embeddings - v2 (2026-08-01),1,6000.00,6000.00
3,Support - standard,1,1340.00,1340.00
```
Looks like duplicate ingestion record created two usage lines.

Omar (RevOps): Do we have a reconciliation flag for duplicates? Might be an ETL blip from metrics pipeline. Either way: need to credit $6,000 and ensure taxes (if any) are handled.

Nina (Acct Rep): Helion asks for refund to CC; prefer credit memo + refund. They said this affected month-end close.

Alex L: Quick numbers: refund = $6,000. Tax on that line was 0 (embeddings nontaxable per region). So credit = $6,000. If we refund to CC, we need payments team to process reversal.

Priya (Dir Finance): Approve a full refund to customer card for $6k. Please document with adj code FIN-DUP-2026-207 and note root cause = metrics duplication. Also, cap the monthly manual refund total for reporting.

Leah (Payments): I can process a card refund but need these details: original payment ID, customer last4, and approval. Nina can you send? Also, refunds to CC may take 5-7 business days to post.

Nina (Acct Rep): Sent DM to Leah with payment ID PAY-98765-08 and card **** 4242. Also attached Helion consent for refund.

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-1580 (amount -6000.00) and linked to INV-2026-0810-HL. Status: pending_refund. Reference FIN-DUP-2026-207.

Leah (Payments): Refund submitted to processor 2026-08-11 10:22Z for $6,000, processor ref: R-554433. ETA posting 3-7 biz days. Refund fee impact = $0.30 + 2.9% (we'll book payment fees reversal).

Omar (RevOps): Opening ticket in eng-metrics to prevent duplicate ingestion: METRICS-2026-99. Please attach sample IDs.

Alex L: Thanks — closing here once refund posts. Nina: please confirm when customer sees refund.

Nina (Acct Rep): Will follow up and update ticket. Adding note to billing QA: test for duplicate usage dedupe at invoicing. :memo:

Alex L: great, thread closed.
